summary: Iteration 3 full-stack test of the 3 new features (mobile layout, auto/offline raids, daily missions) plus a full regression pass. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py to 44 pytest cases (11 new for missions + offline raids) — 43 passed, 1 failed (naive/no-timezone last_tick makes POST /api/tick/offline-raids return 500). Verified GET /api/missions/daily returns exactly 3 unique missions with all 11 required fields and is deterministic per user, claim awards cash/xp/rep and persists (verified via /player/state), double-claim -> 400, unknown mission -> 404, incomplete -> 400, unauthenticated -> 401. Verified /tick/offline-raids: fresh user -> 0 events + hours<0.5, 70h-offline user with 0-security properties -> event list with type/prop/msg/amount, money reduced exactly by total_lost, last_tick advanced; security=100 -> all events 'defended' and total_lost=0. Frontend E2E on the public URL: /tick/offline-raids and /missions/daily are both called on Game mount; DAILY MISSIONS widget renders 3 mission-{id} items with title/desc/progress bar/target/reward, CLAIM buttons appear only for complete+unclaimed, claiming shows the success toast, HUD cash rises by the exact reward, button disappears and the item is greyed + line-through. Mobile (390x844): zero horizontal overflow, sidebar hidden (left=-260), menu-btn present, slides in (left=0), closes via X, backdrop click and tab selection (which also navigates). Responsive grids verified: cards-5 = 3 cols @1200, 2 @900, 1 @560; dashboard-grid collapses to 1 col <=900. Desktop regression all pass with zero console errors: arsenal buy, crew hire, property buy + upgrade-security, bank deposit/withdraw, business buy + collect, heist run -> outcome, PvP raid (needs level 5+), rankings/Progress (12 rows, iteration_2 500 bug is fixed).

minor.issue: 500 TypeError 'can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' when a user doc has a timezone-naive last_tick (datetime.fromisoformat at server.py:919 is not normalised). No such docs exist today (0/11 users), but any legacy/manually written value breaks the mount call for that user. Fix: if last.tzinfo is None: last = last.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).

When hours < 0.5 the endpoint returns early WITHOUT updating last_tick and without total_lost/money keys in the response (contract says it always returns { events, hours, total_lost, money } and forces a last_tick update). Frontend only reads data.events so it doesn't break, but the response shape is inconsistent.
Gang raid 'steal' is subtracted from user.money but prop['cash_stash'] is never decremented, so the same stash can be looted again and again on every future tick.
mission_quick ('Complete 3 Quick Operations') and mission_heist ('Complete 1 Heist tier operation') both read stats.ops_completed, so any operation of any tier progresses both — tier is not checked.

action_items: Make HUD responsive below 900px (wrap/stack stat blocks or hide heat/rep behind a compact row) — heat, reputation and the icon buttons are currently off-screen on phones.
Replace the 404 HERO_BG unsplash URL in /app/frontend/src/game/images.js (all other CARD_BG images return 200).
server.py:919 — normalise naive last_tick to UTC before subtracting (currently 500s).
server.py:921 — early-return branch should still update last_tick and return total_lost/money for a consistent contract.

server.py get_daily_missions() — replace hash(user['id']) with a stable digest; Python string hash is salted per process so a backend restart reshuffles a user's daily missions mid-day (already-claimed keys become stale and the user can claim a fresh set of 3 rewards the same day).
server.py offline raids — decrement prop['cash_stash'] when a gang loots it.
critical_code_review_comments: get_daily_missions() seeds with `int(YYYYMMDD) + hash(user['id']) % 1000`. CPython salts str hashes per process (PYTHONHASHSEED not pinned in supervisor), so the mission set is only stable for the lifetime of the uvicorn process — a restart/reload (the server runs with --reload) changes the 3 missions for every user, defeating the missions_claimed date_missionid guard and allowing repeat rewards on the same day. Use hashlib.sha256(user['id'].encode()).hexdigest() -> int instead.

/api/missions/daily returns complete=(prog>=target and not claimed), so a claimed mission reports complete=false; the flag mixes 'goal met' with 'claim available'. Frontend relies on this to hide the CLAIM button, but the field name is misleading for any other consumer.

Game.jsx useEffect posts /tick/offline-raids on every mount; under React StrictMode it fires twice (observed 2 requests). The second is a no-op only because of the hours<0.5 guard — keep that guard if the early-return branch is changed.
Home.jsx still swallows all three API calls in empty catch{} (no loading/error state for missions) — a 500 from /missions/daily leaves a permanent 'Loading missions...' with no error surfaced.

rca_of_the_issue: offline-raids 500: server.py:919 datetime.fromisoformat(user['last_tick']) returns a naive datetime for any value stored without an offset, and it is subtracted from an aware datetime.now(timezone.utc) -> TypeError -> 500 (confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). Mobile HUD: HUD.jsx header uses a hard-coded gridTemplateColumns '270px 1fr auto' with height 96 and no media query, so the 4 stat blocks + 4 icon buttons need ~700px and overflow (hidden) past a 390px viewport.
